remarks: Looking for a rental home? Look no further than this beautifully maintained 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom unit at the highly sought-after Carriage House. Bright and airy, this home boasts stunning views of the serene Five Mile River. The spacious kitchen is a chef's dream, featuring generous counter space, sleek stainless steel appliances, a gas range, and ample storage for all your culinary needs. The open floor plan seamlessly connects the living and dining areas, perfect for entertaining or relaxing in comfort. The primary bedroom is a true retreat, complete with  an en-suite bathroom and a large walk-in closet. The second bedroom, along with an additional full bathroom, provides plenty of flexibility to suit your needs. The unit comes with a reserved parking space, plentiful parking for visitors, and elevator convenience. The Carriage House, set amid storybook-like surroundings, is perfect for tranquil riverside wanderings. With easy access to I-95 and nearby Metro-North stations in Rowayton and Darien, commuting to New York City is a breeze- just a 55-minute ride!
